No claims reported. I found no public YouTube, LinkedIn or Reddit content about East Bengaluru property for 12-15 Oct 2026.

Platform access:
- Reddit: WebFetch refused the domain, so r/bangalore could not be read at all.
- LinkedIn: only the sign-in page loaded. Public posts were not reachable without logging in.
- YouTube: the results page returned only footer text, with no video listings.
- Searches with site: filters for all three platforms returned only developer blogs, broker blogs and listing pages. None was dated inside the window, and none could be quoted verbatim from a page I opened.

Pages not opened: the Cushman & Wakefield Q2 2026 PDF and the Deccan Herald East Corporation tax-auction article both returned HTTP 403. Their search snippets (C&W: East submarket 26% of Q2 2026 launches; DH: KR Puram zone auction of six properties over tax dues) are unverified by me. I did not report them because I have no verbatim excerpt or confirmed date.

Search-snippet items that were stale or undated: Abhee Ventures 45-acre Gunjur township (28 May 2026), the C&W Q1 2026 East share of 57% (13 May 2026), Mana Verdant Terraces (undated), and various Sarjapur and Budigere plot listings (undated). Pink Line opening dates differ between sources (Wikipedia, NBR, Colliers), so I made no infrastructure claim. All of these came from interested-party or aggregator sources, and none was in the window. This is a valid "nothing new" result for the window, but it reflects limited access to the social platforms rather than proof that nothing was posted there.
